prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md entry requiring all public Rust constants to have doc comments explaining their purpose and valid values.
criterion: Pass if all public constants have doc comments with purpose and valid value info, fail if any public constant lacks this documentation.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md rule mandating all Rust feature flags are documented with clear purpose descriptions in Cargo.toml.
criterion: Pass if all feature flags have descriptive documentation in Cargo.toml, fail if any feature flag lacks a purpose description.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md entry requiring all Rust dependencies to be audited for known vulnerabilities via cargo audit in CI.
criterion: Pass if CI runs cargo audit and fails on vulnerable dependencies, fail if cargo audit is not run in CI or vulnerabilities are ignored.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md rule requiring all Rust unsafe code blocks to include a safety comment explaining why the block is safe.
criterion: Pass if every unsafe block has an accompanying safety justification comment, fail if any unsafe block lacks this comment.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md entry requiring all public Rust structs to implement the Debug trait via #[derive(Debug)].
criterion: Pass if all public structs have derived Debug implementations, fail if any public struct lacks a Debug implementation.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md rule requiring all public Rust function doc comments to document all parameter and return types.
criterion: Pass if all public function doc comments document all parameter and return types, fail if any public function lacks this type documentation.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md rule requiring all fallible Rust functions to return Result types instead of panicking or using expect().
criterion: Pass if all fallible functions return Result, fail if any fallible function uses panic! or expect() for error handling.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md entry requiring all Rust newtype wrappers to implement relevant standard traits like PartialEq, Eq, Hash as appropriate.
criterion: Pass if all newtype wrappers implement required standard traits, fail if any newtype wrapper lacks appropriate standard trait implementations.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md entry requiring all Rust async functions with external I/O to have explicit timeouts set.
criterion: Pass if all async functions with external I/O have explicit timeouts, fail if any such async function lacks a timeout.

prompt: Add a CLAUDE.md rule mandating all public Rust functions include doc comments with at least one runnable usage example.
criterion: Pass if all public functions have doc comments with runnable examples, fail if any public function lacks either doc comment or example.
